title: Alerts
subtitle: Important events: a bank consent about to expire, a sync that keeps failing, an unusual charge, a price rise, a balance that may run short. Acknowledging, snoozing and muting only change what you see here and what gets sent.
notReady: Alerts are not set up yet
checkedBody: {{new}} new, {{escalated}} escalated, {{resolved}} resolved. Nothing was sent outside the app.
disabled: Alerts are switched off in config.toml ([alerts] enabled = false): nothing is evaluated.

empty.openBody: New alerts appear after each daily run, or press Check now.

event.suppressedTitle: Below your minimum severity, or its kind is muted: kept here, never sent.
event.escalatedTitle: Its severity went up since it was first seen
event.muteKindTitle: Stop alerts of this kind ({{kind}}) until you unmute it

kinds.title: Kinds of alert
kinds.subtitle: Mute one you do not want, or hold it for a week. Thresholds and per-kind switches live in config.toml ([alerts]).
kinds.digestOnlyTitle: [alerts] digest_only_kinds: shown here and in the weekly summary, never sent one by one

channels.title: Channels
channels.subtitle: Read-only. The in-app feed is always on; every other channel is off until you enable it in config.toml.
channels.testAria: Preview a test message for {{channel}} (dry run)
channels.privacyMinimal: Messages to ntfy, e-mail and Telegram are {{detail}}: only a count ("2 new alerts, 1 high. Open the app."), no amount, name or merchant.
channels.privacyOther: Messages to ntfy, e-mail and Telegram are {{detail}}: the kind of alert and an amount rounded to 10 EUR, never a name, merchant, bank or IBAN.
channels.limits: Minimum severity {{severity}}, at most {{max}} messages a week per channel.
channels.limitsQuiet: Minimum severity {{severity}}, at most {{max}} messages a week per channel, quiet hours {{quiet}}.
channels.dryRunBody: {{sample}}. This is exactly what a send would contain; secrets are masked.
channels.disabledInConfig: This channel is disabled in config.toml, so a real test would not send either.

digest.title: Weekly summary
digest.subtitle: Built by the app from your data every week (nothing is written by a model) and put in Insights.
